# Restoring the Lucson Sphere
The city is surrounded by a wall of deadly murk, and it can only survive thanks to the [color=yellow]Lucson Sphere[/color] - an artifact that drives the murk away.
The round's events begin the moment the sphere's protective shell cracks and its power starts to fade. The citizens' goal is to restore the sphere with the [color=yellow]Restoration Ritual[/color] within [color=red]1 hour[/color], or the murk will consume the city.
## Preparing for the ritual
Unfortunately for you, the ritual requires [color=yellow]4 light shards[/color] and the [color=yellow]"Restoration of the sphere" spellbook[/color].
All of these are so conveniently sold by the Shadow Caravan, which is certainly not connected to the pressing murk problem...
Every round, the Shadow Caravan demands different resources in exchange for the light shards and the book.
Mostly, the traders demand resources that take organization and a division of duties among the city's players to obtain. And of course, someone will surely try to sabotage their gathering.
## The ritual
Next to the Lucson Sphere you can find the ritual site: 4 altars around the sphere. To begin the ritual, place the 4 purchased shards on the altars and cast the "Restoration of the sphere" spell on the sphere itself.
This starts the ritual. During the ritual, the Lucson Sphere sheds its protective shell, becoming [color=yellow]vulnerable[/color], and spends 2 minutes forming a new shell.
While the new shell is forming, [color=red]the core can easily be destroyed[/color] if it takes enough damage. Destroying the core means an instant defeat for the city, which is then consumed by the murk. If the ritual is carried through to the end, the round ends in the city's victory.
